bestBets.overview: PRINCE OF PORTLAND got back and made nice ground in first go on synthetic track and the winner Pocketfullofcash looked very smart on the surface. Ran meeting 2nd best last 800 and 600m.  Suited by the good tempo. BACK UP BARBIE looks ready for a strong return. Jumpout form has been on wet tracks, but was green and met trouble when placed on Good 4 last December. ROJA CALIENTE has the draw to be in a controlling position on the back of some nice jump outs. Raceday rider has had a feel in recent jump outs.  WHAT ONCE WAS was in the market on debut on turf and ran well. Led but stuck on well in synthetic debut here. Winner of that race was $1.55 favourite. 3kg claim bring in well under rivals, leader. lots to like.

raceTips.comment: Prince of Portland was supported at long odds at Pakenham and ran on well, beating subsequent winner Port Phillip. There's an opportunity for him to get a better trail into the race here. Back Up Barbie is in a new stable and maps well but she can hit a flat spot in her races. Roja Caliente might be the best of the newcomers. What Once Was is speedy and with a 3kg claim may be hard to run down.

bestBets.overview: Even race. SUMALUV looked to have improved off a break when defying big starting price when narrowly beaten by Begg-trained maiden who has always shown a bit. Twice placed in Cranbourne synthetic jumpouts so expecting will handle it here.Thought GUN CITY did enough in latest jump out against the likes of Novamira up the straight at Flemington to be suited by 1200m on home track.  CATONAHOTINROOF comes off a very long break, changes stables, but comes here with three synthetic jumpouts, two at Pakenham and one at Cranbourne. Blinkers go on first time, a positive lead. KUNG FU PANDA showed enough in strong maiden on Pakenham synthetic first up to improve again. OCEAN SURGE stalked the pace in Cranbourne synthetic jumpout and got very close as first three gapped the rest. SATOSHI is a likely improver back on firmer surface after racing greenly on debut in city class and has been gelded since. PLATINUM RUSH was a vast improver when tried on the synthetic here last start.

raceTips.comment: I thought Platinum Rush was over the odds at double figures in early markets. An improved run first time this surface last start when arguably a little stiff. Drawn to be a pair closer in the run and did run well in a couple of stronger maidens with its previously stable last prep. Catonahotinroof is returning from a long spell but has the Begg/Childs combination and has been jumping out well-enough on the Pakenham synthetic with blinkers. Ocean Surge jumped out well behind Caulfield winner Angels Fury and also again on the synthetic at Cranbourne. Gun City has been given quiet hit outs, and I worry he could get a long way back from a wide gate here. Sumaluv saved ground after a slow start at Bendigo. If she does the same here it may be difficult to perform as well so I'm risking her.

bestBets.overview: STUNTMAN didn't like the soft track first up from a break and no surprise to see him here on firmer deck on home track. Have to rate him highly on strong second to the smart Plunger in big value maiden on firm track. The latter then won the $250k Final of that Future Stars series. SCAROLE had no luck on wet track in debut and it looked a strong maiden, with the winner likely to advance to metro level. Has placed on synthetic here. RICH KING sat wide at Terang at latest start and was easily best on-pacer in the race. Winner on Pakenham synthetic in 1000m jump out to be ready for this. AURUM STAR was a bit keen on debut, but still found the line on debut. Blinkers applied straight away to get him to focus up.

raceTips.comment: Rich King and Aurum Star are my preferred two in a decent race. I'm leaning towards Rich King because of the strength of races he contested last campaign. He's got an awkward head carriage but if he can roll forward and not be caught flat footed he will run. Aurum Star will appreciate a slight rise in trip after a good debut at Swan Hill. He just needs to settle with blinkers on. Scarole made some ground after getting back at Geelong. He can settle closer here. Stuntman was poor first up but maybe it was the wet ground, however both his runs at 1400m haven't lived up to his debut.

LIFE SENTENCE was narrowly beaten here last start in higher grade and had a good margin to third.  Won or placed 12 of 13 on synthetic tracks! IMPENDING WAR and MR BUTT'S BOAT next picks.

raceTips.comment: Saludar had blinkers first time, sat on a slow pace and kicked away for a visually impressive maiden win here last time. He's the progressive horse of the race and closed well at Sandown at the end of his last prep. However, he's short enough at $2.00. I'm giving local Life Sentence another chance. I thought he was good against Zorb here last time and that horse has won again since. He's back to 62 class, and the 3kg claim of apprentice Zac Moore (who rides this track well) is helpful. Not sure how comfortable Mr Butt's Boats was on this surface two runs back but he was in behind horses. On his Swan Hill run since he's also got a chance. Powerbound will spot them a start but up to 1400 and away from wet tracks may see him run well. Impending War needs to lift.

Margin Call is going well but 1200m is a new test. Endless Forever is suited back in distance and could be an improver on drier footing.
